# `apple` operations

10 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all references](index.md).

### apple.devices

Apple devices on the Mac. read-only, idempotent.

Read Simulator and connected physical-device inventories using Xcode on a configured SSH Mac.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.devices '{"remote":"<remote>"}'
```

### apple.project

Read Xcode project. read-only, idempotent.

Read targets, schemes and configurations from an Xcode project on a configured SSH Mac.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)
- `project` string, required

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.project '{"remote":"<remote>","project":"<project>"}'
```

### apple.build

Build native iOS app. writes.

Synchronize an optional local project, then build the selected Xcode scheme on the Mac.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)
- `project` string, required
- `scheme` string, required (non-empty)
- `destination` string, required
- `path` string: Optional local project to sync before execution
- `configuration` string (one of debug, release; default "debug")
- `team_id` string
- `allow_provisioning_updates` boolean (default false)
- `timeout` integer (30 to 86400; default 3600)

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.build '{"remote":"<remote>","project":"<project>","scheme":"<scheme>","destination":"<destination>"}'
```

### apple.test

Run XCTest / XCUITest. writes.

Run native XCTest/XCUITest and fetch the result bundle even when tests fail.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)
- `project` string, required
- `scheme` string, required (non-empty)
- `destination` string, required
- `path` string: Optional local project to sync before execution
- `configuration` string (one of debug, release; default "debug")
- `team_id` string
- `allow_provisioning_updates` boolean (default false)
- `timeout` integer (30 to 86400; default 3600)
- `only_testing` array of string (up to 100 items)

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.test '{"remote":"<remote>","project":"<project>","scheme":"<scheme>","destination":"<destination>"}'
```

### apple.archive

### apple.export

Export and fetch IPA. writes.

Export an existing xcarchive with a supplied ExportOptions.plist and download resulting IPAs.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)
- `archive` string, required
- `export_options` string, required
- `allow_provisioning_updates` boolean (default false)
- `timeout` integer (30 to 86400; default 3600)

```sh

```

### apple.simulator

Control Apple Simulator. **destructive, ask first**.

Boot, shut down, install, launch, terminate, open a URL or capture an actual Apple Simulator on the Mac.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)
- `device` string, required
- `action` string, required (one of boot, shutdown, install, launch, terminate, openurl, screenshot)
- `app` string
- `bundle_id` string
- `url` string

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.simulator '{"remote":"<remote>","device":"<device>","action":"boot"}'
```

### apple.device

Control iPhone on the Mac. **destructive, ask first**.

Install or launch a native app or terminate a process on a physical iPhone using devicectl.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)
- `device` string, required
- `action` string, required (one of install, launch, terminate)
- `app` string
- `bundle_id` string
- `pid` integer (1 to 2147483647)

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.device '{"remote":"<remote>","device":"<device>","action":"install"}'
```

### apple.profile

Instruments recording. writes.

Record an Instruments template against a process using Xcode and download the trace plus its table of contents.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)
- `device` string, required
- `process` string, required (non-empty)
- `template` string (default "Time Profiler")
- `seconds` integer (1 to 600; default 10)

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.profile '{"remote":"<remote>","device":"<device>","process":"<process>"}'
```

### apple.store

Upload App Store build. writes.

Validate or upload an IPA with altool and an App Store Connect API key already present on the Mac.

- `remote` string, required (non-empty)
- `ipa` string, required
- `key_id` string, required
- `issuer` string, required
- `key_directory` string, required
- `action` string (one of validate, upload; default "validate")

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.store '{"remote":"<remote>","ipa":"<ipa>","key_id":"<key_id>","issuer":"<issuer>","key_directory":"<key_directory>"}'
```
